botanical-bookshop.description: Warm sandstone over a deep green shopfront, slate roof and restrained brass details.
botanical-bookshop.composition: Keep body and trim dominant. Concentrate green around the entrance and planting; use brass only for small focal details.

rose-townhouse.description: Muted sand-green walls, warm tan stonework and a dark red roof.
rose-townhouse.composition: Use a quieter body colour beside the bookshop. Repeat warm trim on sills, cornice and roof finials; keep flowers localized.

harbour-cafe.description: Sand-blue walls with white trim, a warm roof and yellow accents.
harbour-cafe.composition: Let the blue/white facade carry the scene; reserve warm colours for awnings, flowers and the roof.
